UP Police Chief's Cow Slaughter Remarks Spark Controversy

A Rampur Police Chief stated that "true Muslims" do not slaughter or eat cows during the month of Shravan, reportedly using an expletive. Following an outcry, the police chief backtracked on his statement. The remarks were made during a period when cow slaughter is a sensitive issue.
